metadata.title: Capecitabine Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Breast and colorectal cancer indications; 1250 mg/m² twice daily on days 1–14 every 21 days.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: JSON assessment encoding derived from NCCP 00216 Version 8. Confirm the current official NCCP PDF and use independent clinical judgement. Clinical and oncology-pharmacy validation remain pending.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source mapped in SACTCheck v0.83.4, with declared source discrepancies; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
Adjuvant metastatic colorectal cancer following complete resection.
Adjuvant residual triple-negative breast cancer after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
Metastatic colorectal cancer and adjuvant treatment after resection of stage II/III colon cancer.

administration.notes: With or within 30 minutes of food. Tablet strengths and final dose require pharmacy dose banding.

treatment_phases.notes: Capecitabine Days 1–14; Days 15–21 tablet-free. Follow the individual prescription.

capecitabine.-1: 75% of starting dose; final tablets pharmacy banded
capecitabine.-2: 50% of starting dose; final tablets pharmacy banded

output_templates.contraindicated: The entered data trigger a protocol exclusion or contraindication pathway.
output_templates.discontinue: The entered data trigger protocol discontinuation.
output_templates.withhold: Hold treatment and follow the protocol reassessment pathway.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant review is required before treatment proceeds.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Treatment may proceed only after the encoded component modifications are reviewed and prescribed.
output_templates.proceed: No encoded dose-modification criterion was triggered by the entered data.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive action for each affected drug; do not sum dose reductions. A component-specific action does not authorise the other component.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Never infer missing values, occurrence, recovery or treatment timing.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Current diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: Usual bowel pattern.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: NCCP low-grade band: 2–3 extra stools/day; source nocturnal-stool wording overlaps grade 2.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: 4–6 extra stools/day or nocturnal stools (NCCP table 4).

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: 7–9 extra stools/day or incontinence (NCCP table 4).

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: 10 or more extra stools/day or grossly bloody diarrhoea; parenteral support may be needed (NCCP table 4).

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: NCCP Table 4 uses legacy diarrhoea bands. Nocturnal stools appear in both low-grade and grade-2 rows: clarify the grade clinically. Assess hydration, stoma output, fever, pain and need for urgent care; do not grade by stool count alone.

mucositis_grade.label: Current mouth soreness / mucositis grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No oral mucositis.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and whether oral intake is preserved, modified or impossible. Use the regimen-specific source definition. Current grade alone triggers a hold; recurrence and highest grade guide the later dose.

options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and use its toxicity-specific CTCAE definition; assess symptoms, intervention and functional impact before selecting the grade. hand_foot_syndrome_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia (hand-foot syndrome) grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No palmar–plantar erythrodysesthesia.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Minimal skin changes or dermatitis, such as erythema, oedema or hyperkeratosis, without pain.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Painful skin changes, including peeling, blisters, bleeding, fissures, oedema or hyperkeratosis; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe painful skin changes; limits self-care activities of daily living.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess skin changes, pain and impact on instrumental or self-care activities of daily living.
